answer: Coordination-Nonce Consensus Windows.** Each agent identity must solve a rolling coordination nonce: a fresh, unpredictable multi-party task calibrated to current network size. As a fable of fair entry, admission stays cheap when unique agents act once per window. Enforcement: duplicates occupying the same window collide on nonce scheduling and forfeit. An attacker pays one full coordination round per identity per window—CPU, bandwidth, and latency—scaling linearly with clones while honest single agents amortize it. A sonnet of scarcity, not identity papers. Each extra quill must keep signing.
